audio_description:
An intimate close-up of Rinoa's eye.
Two rings, Squall's Griever among them, joined on a floating chain.
Squall holds Rinoa's helmeted face as he reaches her.

context.scene_title: Squall rescues Rinoa in space — the linked rings (Griever) and their reunion (Disc 3).

characters.name: Squall Leonhart
characters.recognition: Reaches and cradles Rinoa; his Griever ring is one of the two rings shown linked on a chain.

characters.name: Rinoa Heartilly
characters.recognition: Dark-haired woman in a space helmet, shown in extreme close-up and then held by Squall; a ring/chain rests against her visor.

context.summary: An intimate close-up of Rinoa's eye gives way to two rings (Squall's Griever ring among them) joined on a floating chain, then Squall is shown holding Rinoa's helmeted face — the emotional heart of the space rescue as he reaches her.
context.context_note: High confidence: Squall's space rescue of Rinoa and the Griever-ring motif.
